etymology.historical_story: Eesha is documented as a personal name in university profiles, but those records establish usage rather than linguistic ancestry. A name may pass between languages while retaining its spelling, and different families may understand it differently. Without a reliable account of this particular naming tradition, assigning one ancient origin or sacred meaning would turn uncertainty into invented history.
